limitations: Candidate package only; do not relabel as the later logging-fix package.
Image dimensions and rectangle metrics describe retained captures, not the initial configured window size.
Normal close is evidenced by orderly mod unload and graphics destruction; the process exit code was not retained.
The retained external-service record lacks artifact and OS/architecture identity; session metadata supplies separate host context.
Counts cover only 32-byte GXCallDisplayList calls beginning with the selected one-word XF0x100C transfer header.
A 1200ms summary does not stop the Frida interceptor; the retained record alone does not prove detachment.
Observes copied command bytes at the exported CPU boundary, not decoded native draws, GPU completion or pixels.
